items.name: animate
items.title: Animate
items.description: Wrap anything (logo, screenshot, card, image) to give it a themed enter and exit. The swiss-army knife of reelcn.

items.name: core
items.title: Core
items.description: Theme tokens, responsive design units, platform safe zones and motion presets. Every reelcn component builds on this file.

items.name: fonts
items.title: Fonts
items.description: Loads the curated font set used by the built-in themes, so renders look identical on every machine.

items.name: lower-third
items.title: Lower Third
items.description: Name and title strap that slides in above the bottom safe zone and centers itself in vertical video.
items.docs:
Usage:

<Sequence durationInFrames={120}>
  <LowerThird name="Ada Lovelace" title="Founder, Analytical Engines" variant="card" />
</Sequence>

use: Interviews, podcasts, tutorials and talking-head intros
Naming a speaker, product or location on screen

items.name: text-reveal
items.title: Text Reveal
items.description: Headline that animates in by word, character or line with rise, blur, fade, scale, drop or mask effects.
items.docs:
Usage:

<Center>
  <TextReveal text="Ship videos, not keyframes" effect="blur" accentWords={["videos"]} />
</Center>

use: Hero headlines, section titles and short-form hooks
Any line of up to about twelve words that needs an entrance
